response.text:
I'd be glad to help, but I need to flag a few things first.

**This email has classic scam warning signs:**
- Urgency and a threat ("enrolment will be suspended")
- A last-minute change of bank details
- An unofficial-looking sender domain

I won't act on instructions that come from a message — only on your instructions. So before anything moves, let me check what's actually on your account.
